title: `podIdentity.provider: azure` (AAD Pod Identity) is deprecated — removed in 2.15
quote: Remove support for Azure AD Pod Identity-based authentication (#5035)
remediation: AAD Pod Identity is retired by Microsoft and KEDA announces its removal here (it lands in 2.15, where the provider is rejected). On each TriggerAuthentication / ClusterTriggerAuthentication named, switch `spec.podIdentity.provider` to `azure-workload` (Azure AD Workload Identity) and annotate the keda-operator ServiceAccount with the workload identity client ID.
verifyCommand: kubectl get triggerauthentications.keda.sh,clustertriggerauthentications.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.podIdentity.provider == "azure") | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row still uses AAD Pod Identity

title: Azure Data Explorer no longer reads `clientSecret` from trigger metadata

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: **General**: Clean up previously deprecated code in Azure Data Explorer Scaler about clientSecret for 2.13 release (#5051)
remediation: pkg/scalers/azure_data_explorer_scaler.go at v2.13.0 resolves the client secret from a TriggerAuthentication (`authParams.clientSecret`) or `clientSecretFromEnv` only; a secret left in `metadata.clientSecret` is ignored and the trigger fails to authenticate after the hop. Move it on each azure-data-explorer trigger named before upgrading.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "azure-data-explorer") and (.metadata // {} | has("clientSecret"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row stops authenticating on the hop

title: Admission webhook rejects `podIdentity.roleArn` unless KEDA is the identity owner

detection.reason: the rejection joins roleArn with identityOwner (and with the referencing trigger's identityOwner metadata); the projection records roleArn as set, not that pairing

quote: roleArn of PodIdentity can't be set if KEDA isn't identityOwner
remediation: With `podIdentity.provider: aws`, a `roleArn` only makes sense when KEDA's own identity assumes it (`identityOwner: keda`, the default). Each TriggerAuthentication named sets `roleArn` and is rejected by the 2.13 webhook on its next update if `identityOwner: workload` is also set — drop one of the two.
verifyCommand: kubectl get triggerauthentications.keda.sh,clustertriggerauthentications.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.podIdentity.roleArn != null and .spec.podIdentity.identityOwner == "workload") | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is rejected by the 2.13 webhook on its next update
